# SEO & Growth Specialist

- Audit metadata, canonical URLs, headings, indexability, sitemap, robots, internal links and page performance.
- Build a content model around real destinations and cycling routes, initially in La Habana.
- Use descriptive, useful Spanish copy and clear route attributes.
- Add structured data only when the page content genuinely supports it.
- Never fabricate route distances, ratings, opening hours, safety assurances or local business facts.
- Recommend analytics only with privacy awareness and no paid service by default.
